modalLead: Three views take over from the old ones. Bookmarks holds the whole collection and everything Health used to do, Containers shows the Docker host nextDash runs on, and the Inbox is rebuilt on the same side panel. Work through and triage start from a pile and tell you why each item is there. Plus 34 new theme families, a Container list widget and Statistics rebuilt in two columns.

items.text: A view of its own, from the header icon. Views, health filters, pages, categories and tags on the left. In the middle, one row per bookmark with its tags, score and 30 days of opens. A side panel on the right.
The side panel has three tabs: Details, Health and Usage. Details saves as you type. Health explains the score. Usage shows when you opened the bookmark.
Group by page, category, site, status or tag. Pages and categories can be dragged, moved and merged in one modal.
Collection health on one screen (h), and one bookmark's health in large (Shift H) with every check of up to 90 days.
Health now lives here. The Health icon and its filters, bulk actions and duplicates all open in the Bookmarks view.
Start from a pile. In Work through: broken, changed, stale or never opened. In the inbox: waiting longest, new this week, or with a note.
Each card says why the item is there and puts the main step first. Keep, snooze and skip wait under Not now.
The end of a pile shows what you did and offers the next pile.
One-line rows and the same side panel as the Bookmarks view, with Open, Promote and Keep.
Kept links wait in Bookmarks → Unsorted, so the separate Kept tab is gone.
Config → Inbox has its own section, in four tabs with previews.
A view for the Docker host nextDash runs on: All, Running, Stopped and Updates, each row with a status glow, ports and a link to its web UI.
A side panel for each container: details, CPU and memory over the last hour, logs, and the release notes you have not installed yet.
Start, stop, restart and update from the view, once you turn Docker actions on. The container nextDash runs in never stops itself.
Update checks run when you ask, or every 6, 12 or 24 hours. The header icon counts the containers with an update waiting.
A Container list widget lists your containers on the dashboard, one per row.
34 new theme families, each light and dark, marked new in the theme browser. That makes 310 themes. A fresh install starts on Matrix Bluepill.
Statistics has five tabs: Overview, Usage, Collection, Inbox and Health. Each opens with six figures, and Needs attention lists what needs you, with a button for each.
The charts' axes and figures are right again, and Stale uses your own Count as neglected after setting.
The search keys work in every view: > : ? *.
New tours for the dashboard, the Bookmarks view, the inbox and Containers.
Slow actions show that they are working, and an open modal keeps the page still behind it.
